title: When It Comes to Nature vs. Nurture, How Much Do Our Genes Matter?
summary: After centuries, the nature versus nurture debate still rages. Now the fight is over “missing heritability” — whether science can find a way to pinpoint inheritance in the human genome.
body_markdown: After centuries, the nature versus nurture debate still rages. Now the fight is over “missing heritability” — whether science can find a way to pinpoint inheritance in the human genome.
